faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Los Gatos?
faq.answer: Los Gatos homeowners typically invest $9,000 to $22,000 for a full window replacement project. This charming Silicon Valley community features historic Victorians in the downtown, Craftsman bungalows along University Avenue, and luxury hillside estates above the town. Custom sizing is common for older historic homes. Single window installation starts at approximately $700.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Los Gatos?
faq.answer: Yes. Los Gatos requires a building permit for window replacements. Properties within the Historic Preservation District may require approval from the Historic Preservation Committee. Our team manages all Los Gatos permit applications, including historic review submittals, on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Los Gatos?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Los Gatos commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Los Gatos?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Los Gatos replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Los Gatos?
faq.answer: Most Los Gatos projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
